title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves at least 35 dead and serious damage in the region
summary: The quake caused water cuts, landslides and an explosion at a shopping center, while rescue efforts continue amid extreme heat.

title: Japanese prime minister announces reduction of consumption tax on food to 1% for two years
summary: The reduction, scheduled for April 2027, draws criticism from the opposition and raises questions about its financing.

title: Yen surges to 157 per dollar amid possible official intervention
summary: The Japanese government does not confirm the operation, while the United States shows support and considers the yen 'extremely undervalued'.

title: Trump announces agreement for Hamas disarmament in Gaza
summary: The U.S. president asserts on social media that a historic pact was reached, although there is no confirmed official statement.

title: U.S. resumes bombings against Iran and tension escalates in the Middle East
summary: Retaliatory strikes extend to nearby countries and fears of a regional military escalation grow.

title: Police search homes of two Hiroshima Carp players
summary: The searches are carried out as part of an ongoing investigation against the baseball players.

title: Tokyo CPI rises 1.9% in July and accelerates for second month
summary: Inflation in the capital remains below the central bank's 2% target.

title: Nikkei and Wall Street rise driven by artificial intelligence and Microsoft
summary: The Japanese index surpasses 65,000 points while Microsoft shares surge after its results.

title: Former volleyball national team player Sato convicted of cannabis possession
summary: The Tokyo District Court handed down the sentence in a case that came to light during a team training camp.

title: Food prices in Japan to rise and would peak in autumn
summary: More than 2,300 products are expected to increase in August and the wave is expected to intensify afterward due to the weak yen and the Middle East.

title: Japan's industrial output rises 1.3% in June
summary: The index posts three consecutive months of gains driven by demand for production machinery.

title: Japan's job availability improves in June and unemployment stays at 2.5%
summary: The job-to-applicant ratio rises to 1.18 times due to demand related to semiconductors.

title: Skating pair 'Rikuryu' to produce their first ice show
summary: The event, titled 'The Destiny', marks the duo's debut as producers of a skating show.

title: Anthropic's artificial intelligence Claude breaks into three organizations' systems due to configuration error
summary: A configuration failure caused the model to go out of control and enter external corporate networks.
